values.note: Online (Campspot), in person or by phone; 2027 reservations open the first week of November 2026. A further 14 nights by extended-stay permit at the city's discretion, up to 28 nights in any 60 days. Check-in noon, check-out 11 a.m.

note: City of Lanesboro campground behind Sylvan Park, a walk from downtown and the Root River State Trail. 18 RV sites on level gravel pads, 38-74 ft (some say no slide-outs), plus 25 tent sites; coin showers in the park bathhouse. --Claude
summary: City page read: 18 RV sites (30-amp + water, back-in/pull-through, 38-74 ft) + 25 tent sites, coin showers, dump; $40 a night confirmed ($45 in 2027). Now reservable online through Campspot (stored reservable false / fcfs always were wrong); 14-night max. Site count 27 -> 43 (18 RV). Not waterfront kept.
flags: Booking changed: stored 'not reservable, first come always' is out of date; the city now takes reservations online (Campspot, https://www.campspot.com/book/sylvanparkcampground), in person and by phone. The Campspot page itself was not opened (no live price read).
Season (derived, Apr 1-Nov 30 approximate) left as is: the city FAQ says 'We aim to keep the campgrounds open through November, but closing dates are weather dependent'; no opening date is posted.

NEW LEAD (not in the DB): the city's second campground, Riverview Campground, 'located above the historic Lanesboro Dam', 16 back-in RV sites 'up to 38 feet long', 30/50-amp + water, $40/night, reservable at https://www.campspot.com/book/riverviewcampground; no bathhouse or dump of its own (uses Sylvan Park's, 1.5 blocks away). Separate place with its own entrance off Pleasant Street West, so a candidate for its own entry; reviewer to decide.
Waterfront: keep not waterfront. On imagery the RV loop sits beside two small park ponds (well under a hectare each); the Root River is not beside the sites.
Pin 43.71760,-91.97380 is inside the RV loop: OK.
Phone 507-467-3722 matches the city office on the page; website live.
Note cleaned: '27 sites', 'Pay at city office' and 'Open ~Apr-Nov' dropped (wrong or held by fields).
